description: Select elements of a parsed model with a SysML v2 API & Services Query — scope, select, where — or OSLC query text (the Query RPC). Each matched element answers its qualified name, metamodel type and the properties select asked for. A query the service cannot evaluate fails with INVALID_ARGUMENT rather than answering empty. The result is the QueryResponse as protojson writes it.

modelHash.description: the model_hash a parse answered; give this, or paths and/or sources to parse first

oslcQuery.description: OSLC Query 3.0 parameter text, instead of query

paths.description: model files to parse as one model, absolute or relative to the workspace root

query.description: the standard's Query as protojson writes it: {"scope":[qualified names],"select":[properties],"where":{"primitive":{"property":"@type","operator":"PRIMITIVE_OPERATOR_EQUAL","value":["PartUsage"]}}} or a composite {"composite":{"operator":"COMPOSITE_OPERATOR_AND","constraint":[...]}}; empty considers the whole model

sources.description: documents given inline, parsed with paths as one model

language.description: sysml or kerml; empty is inferred from path's extension, sysml when it has none

path.description: name the document is reported by in diagnostics and indexed under; a .kerml extension makes it KerML unless language says otherwise

text.description: the document's source text; empty is an empty document

strictConformance.description: judge the documents as conforming SysML v2: notation no pinned production admits is an error rather than a warning

name: query
